articles.title: Deployment - 29-09-2026
articles.content:
Basics

What is Deployment?
- Applying changes to an existing application using a Patch / Build Files is called as Deployment.

What is Services application?
- It is an application that displays a list of all the programs that actually run in the background.
- Click Win + R and type Services.msc to open the services window.

What is a Patch?
- A targeted Fix of a bug can be called as Patch.

What is a Server and a Client?
- A computer providing services to other computers is called as Server.
- It receives requests from clients, processes those requests, and sends back a response.
- The Client's request is usually sent to Application server which requests the necessary data from the database server. And the database server sends the data to application server and the app server sends the data back to the Client.
- When I access the Google Chrome, this browser can act as a Client - An application requesting services from the server is called as a Client.

What is an Environment?
- A setup where application is installed and running for a particular purpose, where a particular version of the application is running.
- DEV  → development
- QA   → testing
- UAT  → user acceptance
- PROD → live/production use

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Deployment Process

Win + R -> Services.msc

Stop the following services 
 - Text Extraction
 - Format Converter
 - Doc Manager
 - Workflow Escalation. 

In the Support Repository, they will create a job and I have to login as that user and download the files attached to the the job.

Using Win + R, 
 - I have to enter the shared path.
 - Run a batch file which will create the required Folder structure with current date.
 - Login to the Support Repository - Workflow - My Jobs - Process - Atachments - Download the necessary files.
 - Move / paste the files in that respective Folder.  
 - Run the Patch.
 - When we run the Patch - we select incremental Backup which will automatically create a folder with current date. (Full Backup Option will take too much time)
 - Also Update the Bugs List file.
 - The Excel file should be re-named after the assignee.
 - Once the patch work is over, Start the services again and try to login to the application.
 - If you are not able to login - with permission of the team lead you can use the rollback script.



Note: VTPL-079 - \\vtplsvr03\f\InternalRelease\ViciCloud 9.1.1.9

articles.title: User Management
articles.content:
# User Management

## List of Functionalities

### Buttons 
- Add User
- Import User
- Swap User
- Inactive User
- Export to PDF / Excel with
  Current Page / All Pages Dropdown

### Actions
- Edit (Click on Edit)
- We will get 4 options - Update - Add to group - Profile Edit - Cancel.

## List of Columns in the Data Grid
- Photo
- Username
- First Name
- Last Name
- Mobile No.
- User Type
- User Pool
- Department
- Email ID
- Status
- Actions

## Add User (Just Click on the Button)

### Username (Mandatory Field)
- Once user is created, it cannot be changed.
- Min 1 Character is necessary.
- Max 50 Characters.
- Cannot be Blank, as it is Mandatory.  
- Accepts Alphabets, Numbers, and   Alphanumeric characters.
- Cannot create Username Duplicates as it is Case    - insensitive.

### Password / Change Password
- Once password is created, can be updated again.
- Password and Confirm Password has to match.
- It is Case - Sensitive.
- What kind of characters are accepted and how many characters depends on Pwd Rules Tab in the Configuration.

### First Name
- This is a Mandatory Field.
- Min 1
- Max 100
- All characters allowed except few Special Characters like $%<> , 

### Type of User (Mandatory)
- Administration: This user has much higher access then normal or Scanner user.

- Normal - Can't access Admin Module
                - Can't access few Portlets in Dashboard Module like All Jobs, Backup Details, Volume Information, User Information, Logged in Users and Data Extraction.

 - Can't access few Sub - Modules in Manage like Purge Mails, Upload Logo, there is no "ALL USERS" Hyperlink in the recycle Bin. And also, no access to metadata import.

- A normal user cannot access Workflow - Designer but if he is added to a group called as 
"WFDESIGNERGROUP" that allows the normal user to access designer menu.

- Workflow - No Form Reports.

- Reports - No ECM.

- Workflow Reports - Normal - Cannot access User wise Job Details
- Workflow-wise job details only available for the Super-Admin.

- Scanner - Only used to Scan and upload the physical documents into the Repository.

- By Default, this type of user has no permission   for Cabinet Creation and Document type Creation.

###User Pool (Mandatory)

- Named User Pool: Licenses are assigned individually to users. To accommodate new users beyond the license limit, existing users must be removed to free up licenses.

- Concurrent User Pool: Total licenses = 25; total users = 50. Only 25 users can access the repository at a time on a first-come, first-served basis.

### Email ID (Mandatory)

### Cabinet Creation
- User cannot create new Cabinets without this permission.

### User cannot create new Doc Type without this permission.

### User Status
- Set to Active / Inactive.

### Add to group 
- Can add new / existing user / inactive user to any single / Multiple groups.

## Inactive User
- Using this, you can turn active users into Inactive users.
- You can turn single / multiple users into inactive users.

## Swap User

## Export

- You mainly have 2 option in this dropdown for Export.
- Current Page (Option 1)
- All Pages. (Option 2)
- You can Export the User List in Excel / PDF Format.

articles.title: User_Management_Module
articles.content:
# User Management

## 1. Overview
- The User Management module is used to create and manage user accounts in ViciECM.
- It provides functionalities to manage user details, user types, group memberships, permissions, license pools, account status, and user list exports.
- User access depends on the assigned user type, permissions, and group membership.

## 2. User Management Screen

### 2.1 Buttons
- Add User: Opens the form to create a new user account.
- Import User: Provides the functionality to import users.
- Swap User: Provides the user-swapping functionality. The exact workflow requires verification.
- Inactive User: Allows administrators to mark a single user or multiple users as inactive.
- Export to PDF / Excel: Exports the user list in PDF or Excel format.
  - Current Page
  - All Pages

### 2.2 Actions Menu
- Clicking **Edit** displays the following options:
  - Update: Used to update user details.
  - Add to Group: Assigns a user to one or more groups.
  - Profile Edit: Opens the profile-editing functionality.
  - Cancel: Cancels the current action.
- The exact difference between Update and Profile Edit should be confirmed in the application.

### 2.3 Data Grid Columns
- Photo
- Username
- First Name
- Last Name
- Mobile No.
- User Type
- User Pool
- Department
- Email ID
- Status
- Actions

## 3. Add User
- Clicking **Add User** opens the form used to create a new user account.

### 3.1 Username
- Mandatory field.
- Minimum length: 1 character.
- Maximum length: 50 characters.
- Accepts alphabets, numbers, and alphanumeric combinations.
- Duplicate usernames are not allowed, regardless of differences in letter casing.
- Once created, the username cannot be changed.

### 3.2 Password / Confirm Password
- A password is configured during user creation and can be updated later.
- Password and Confirm Password must match.
- Passwords are case-sensitive.
- Accepted characters and password length depend on the rules configured in the Pwd Rules tab under Configuration.

### 3.3 First Name
- Mandatory field.
- Minimum length: 1 character.
- Maximum length: 100 characters.
- Certain special characters are restricted, including $, %, <, and >.
- The complete list of restricted characters should be confirmed in the application.

### 3.4 Type of User
- Mandatory field.
- Determines the user's access to application modules and functionalities.

#### Administration
- Has higher access privileges than Normal and Scanner users.

#### Normal
- Cannot access the Admin module.
- Cannot access the following Dashboard functionalities:
  - All Jobs
  - Backup Details
  - Volume Information
  - User Information
  - Logged-in Users
  - Data Extraction
- Cannot access the following Manage functionalities:
  - Purge Mails
  - Upload Logo
  - ALL USERS hyperlink in the Recycle Bin
  - Metadata Import
- Cannot access Workflow Designer by default.
- Membership in WFDESIGNERGROUP allows a Normal user to access the Designer menu.

#### Workflow
- Cannot access Form Reports.

#### Reports
- Cannot access ECM.

#### Workflow Reports
- Normal users cannot access User-wise Job Details.
- Workflow-wise Job Details are available only to the Super Admin, according to the supplied application rules.

#### Scanner
- Intended for scanning and uploading physical documents into the repository.
- By default, has no permission to create cabinets or document types.

### 3.5 User Pool
- **Mandatory field.
- Determines how user licenses are allocated.

#### Named User Pool
- Licenses are assigned individually to users.
- When the license limit is reached, existing license allocations may need to be freed to accommodate additional users, according to the application's licensing rules.

#### Concurrent User Pool
- Example configuration: 25 licenses for 50 registered users.
- Under this configuration, up to 25 users can access the repository concurrently.
- Access is allocated on a first-come, first-served basis, according to the supplied application behavior.
- These figures are an example configuration, not a universal system limit.

### 3.6 Email ID
- Mandatory field.
- An email address must be provided when creating a user.
- Email format validation and duplicate-email restrictions should be confirmed in the application.

### 3.7 Cabinet Creation Permission
- Controls whether the user can create new cabinets.
- When permission is granted, the user can create cabinets, subject to other applicable access controls.
- When permission is not granted, the user cannot create new cabinets.

### 3.8 Document Type Creation Permission
- Controls whether the user can create new document types.
- When permission is granted, the user can create document types, subject to other applicable access controls.
- When permission is not granted, the user cannot create new document types.

### 3.9 User Status
- Available statuses:
  - Active
  - Inactive
- The effects of deactivation on login access, existing sessions, and license allocation should be verified separately.

## 4. Add to Group
- Allows administrators to assign users to one or more application groups.
- Supports:
  - Adding a newly created user to a group.
  - Adding an existing user to a group.
  - Adding an inactive user to a group.
  - Assigning a user to a single group.
  - Assigning a user to multiple groups.
- Group membership may provide access to additional functionalities.
- Example: Membership in WFDESIGNERGROUP allows a Normal user to access the Workflow Designer menu.

## 5. Inactive User
- Allows administrators to deactivate user accounts.
- Supports deactivation of a single user or multiple users.
- The selected users are intended to be marked as Inactive.
- Login, session, and license-allocation behavior should be verified through application testing.

## 6. Swap User
- The Swap User button is available on the User Management screen.
- Reference value: Hello_Testing_Github_4516.
- The exact purpose, input requirements, and expected outcome should be documented after verifying the functionality in the application.

## 7. Export User List
- Supported formats:
  - Excel
  - PDF
- The export scope can be selected from the dropdown.

### 7.1 Current Page
- Exports the user records displayed on the current page.

### 7.2 All Pages
- Exports the user list across all pages.

### 7.3 Available Export Combinations
- Current Page - Excel
- Current Page - PDF
- All Pages - Excel
- All Pages - PDF

## 8. Key Business Rules
- Username is mandatory, unique regardless of letter casing, and cannot be changed after creation.
- Username length must be between 1 and 50 characters.
- Password validation follows the rules configured in the Pwd Rules tab.
- First Name, Type of User, User Pool, and Email ID are mandatory.
- User type determines access to specific application modules and functionalities.
- Group membership can provide access to additional functionalities.
- Cabinet creation and document type creation depend on their respective permissions.
- Users can be marked as Active or Inactive.
- Named and Concurrent User Pools follow different license allocation models.
- User lists can be exported to PDF or Excel for the current page or all pages.

## 9. Testing Focus Areas

### 9.1 Field Validation
- Verify mandatory-field validation.
- Verify Username minimum and maximum length.
- Verify case-insensitive duplicate Username validation.
- Verify that Username cannot be changed after creation.
- Verify Password and Confirm Password matching.
- Verify password case sensitivity and configured password rules.
- Verify First Name length and restricted-character validation.
- Verify email validation rules implemented in the application.

### 9.2 Access Control and Permissions
- Verify access restrictions for each user type.
- Verify Normal user restrictions across Dashboard, Manage, and Workflow functionalities.
- Verify Workflow Designer access through WFDESIGNERGROUP.
- Verify cabinet and document type creation permissions.

### 9.3 User and Group Management
- Verify Update, Add to Group, Profile Edit, and Cancel options.
- Verify group assignment for new, existing, and inactive users.
- Verify single-user and multiple-user deactivation.
- Verify the resulting account status after deactivation.
- Verify the Swap User workflow after establishing its expected behavior.

### 9.4 License Management
- Verify Named User Pool license allocation.
- Verify Concurrent User Pool behavior when the configured concurrent-user limit is reached.
- Verify application behavior when available licenses are exhausted.

### 9.5 Export Functionality
- Verify export to Excel and PDF.
- Verify Current Page and All Pages options.
- Verify exported record count and data accuracy.
- Verify that exported data corresponds to the selected scope.

## 10. Summary
- The User Management module centralizes user account administration, access control, group assignment, license allocation, and account status management.
- Key controls include username uniqueness, password policy enforcement, role-based access, permission management, and license allocation.
- Testing should focus on field validation, access restrictions, user lifecycle operations, license behavior, and export accuracy.
- Unverified behavior should be confirmed before the notes are treated as an approved specification.
